node.statement: Let U_+ be the union of the coordinate fibers in T_+ and D_+ := sum_{Q in T_+}d_Q = sum_{Q in T_+}|d_Q|. Summing R := p_f-p_v+A(q-p_v) over U_+ gives R(U_+) = p_f(U_+)-c(U_+)+A*D_+, hence A*D_+ = c(U_+)+R(U_+)-p_f(U_+). The tail cap gives c(U_+) <= K_C*delta, the residual bound gives R(U_+) <= ||R||_1 <= K_R*delta, and def-negative-mass gives -p_f(U_+) <= nu(p_f) <= delta. Thus A*D_+ <= (K_C+K_R+1)*delta and, because A>=4, sum_{Q in T_+}|d_Q| <= (K_C+K_R+1)*delta/4.
